narrative.intro: B I shows concentrated federal contract activity in FY2026 to date. B I obligated $254M in contract obligations across 5 awards for the fiscal year to date, with an average award size of $50.8M and obligations up 33.4% year over year. Current-year totals are partial. Facilities Support Services accounts for the bulk of FY2026 to date obligations at $247M, with a smaller allocation to Investigation and Personal Background Check Services at $6.5M. Historical obligations trend shows variation by fiscal year: FY21 $281M, FY22 $270M, FY23 $314M, FY24 $288M, and FY25 $190M. The FY2026 to date total of $254M follows a lower FY25 and a higher FY23. This profile points to a business centered on facilities support, delivered through a small number of relatively large awards, and producing a notable year-over-year rise in obligations so far in FY2026.
